hf.title: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
hf.abstract: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) requires a method that can understand, generate, reason, and act across diverse domains and modalities. Rather than relying on a single model to master every capability, a promising path toward AGI now is to orchestrate a heterogeneous ecosystem of specialized models, tools, and policies (candidates) into a unified AI system. At the heart of this vision lies a fundamental question: how can an AI system dynamically select and coordinate the most capable candidate for each task while balancing performance and computational cost? In this work, we present Route Anything, a unified framework for studying model and policy routing across general-purpose AI systems. We develop a unified theoretical foundation that characterizes optimal routing under quality--cost trade-offs and establishes how the information available to a router determines its attainable performance. To systematically investigate routing across diverse capabilities, we first construct an omni-modal trajectory matrix spanning 25 benchmarks across language understanding, image, video, and speech generation, coding and workplace agents, and robotic manipulation, comprising 374,401 scored runs from 452 candidate configurations. Building on this framework, we train and test different routers to investigate the potential of omni-modal model routing, the capabilities of learned routers, and the conditions under which routing improves efficiency. Our results reveal substantial opportunities for capability orchestration: per-input oracle routing outperforms the best fixed candidate by 5.4 points, and learned routers outperform it by 0.3 points across 16 benchmarks, by 2.1 points on video generation, and by 1.1 points on robot manipulation while using 24% less policy time. More importantly, routing raises efficiency by 8.82x on average compared with the reference model.
hf.titleZh: Route Anything：通用人工智能系统中的模型与策略路由研究
hf.summaryZh: 面向通用 AI 系统如何按任务动态选择模型、工具与策略并平衡质量与成本的问题，构建统一的理论框架，刻画质量—成本权衡下的最优路由，并说明路由器可获得的信息如何决定其性能上限。工作构建了覆盖语言理解、图像/视频/语音生成、编程与办公 Agent、机器人操作等 25 个 benchmark、452 个候选配置、374401 条打分轨迹的全模态轨迹矩阵，并训练测试多种路由器。结果显示：逐输入 oracle 路由比最佳固定候选高 5.4 分，学习型路由器在 16 个基准上高 0.3 分、视频生成高 2.1 分、机器人操作高 1.1 分且策略耗时减少 24%；相比参考模型平均带来 8.82 倍效率提升。
hf.reason: 多模型路由与能力编排，属系统效率与 Agent 方向，但覆盖大量生成类任务

hf.title: Words Caught in the Heart: Simulating Person-Specific Expression for Self-Opaque Clients in Psychotherapy
hf.abstract: Psychotherapy clients may experience distress before they can coherently describe it, and their expression changes with emotion, perceived safety, and trust. Large language model-based client simulators often rely on clinically organized case descriptions, which can encourage responses explaining the client's difficulties more clearly than their current understanding warrants. We propose Pandora, a psychotherapy client simulation framework that models how psychological experience becomes situated, individual expression. Pandora updates psychological and relational states in response to therapist interventions, constructs subjective appraisals and attributions, and plans response content and strategy. A separate expression planner combines these decisions with language patterns distilled from the client's utterances to guide linguistic realization. We evaluate Pandora against five baselines on 115 cases from four counseling and motivational interviewing datasets. It achieves the highest expression similarity and overall disclosure-alignment score among the compared systems. In a four-evaluator study of 45 matched disclosure items, Pandora receives AI-like judgments in 7.2% of ratings, compared with 43.3--67.2% for the baselines and 35.6% without expression planning. The ablation also reduces expression similarity. These results support explicit expression planning in client simulation to improve alignment with individual language patterns and reduce perceived AI-like expression in the evaluated setting.
hf.titleZh: 困在心头的言语：为心理治疗中自我认知不清晰的来访者模拟个体化表达
hf.summaryZh: 心理治疗来访者常在能清晰描述困扰之前就已感到痛苦，而依赖临床整理案例的LLM来访者模拟器往往表达得比其当下理解更清楚。Pandora框架据此建模心理经验如何转化为情境化的个体表达：随治疗师干预更新心理与关系状态，生成主观评价与归因，规划回应内容与策略，再由独立表达规划器结合从该来访者话语中蒸馏的语言模式完成语言实现。在四个咨询与动机式访谈数据集的115个案例上，其表达相似度与披露对齐得分最高；45条匹配披露项的四评估者研究中仅7.2%评分被判为“像AI”，基线为43.3%–67.2%，去掉表达规划后升至35.6%。
hf.reason: 心理治疗来访者模拟，属垂直应用，仅与LLM角色模拟沾边

hf.title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
hf.abstract: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks, but their long chain-of-thought often incurs substantial inference costs by continuing to deliberate after sufficient information has been obtained. Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo detects candidate overthinking states from the model's own traces, freezes the corresponding reasoning prefixes, regenerates shorter verified continuations from the same states, and trains on the resulting state-conditioned preference pairs with DPO. This formulation teaches the model when to continue reasoning and when to conclude, rather than simply encouraging shorter trajectories overall. We construct training data entirely from self-generated mathematical traces and evaluate LoCo on five mathematical and three code generation benchmarks. LoCo reduces completion length by 41.7\%--45.4\% on mathematics and 23.4\%--36.3\% on code, while maintaining or improving accuracy and achieving the best AUC across all code benchmarks. LoCo consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off on mathematics and transfers effectively to code generation despite math-only training, demonstrating the cross-domain generality of local preference learning for reasoning compression. The code and model will be publicly released at https://github.com/MuyaoYuan/LoCo.
hf.titleZh: 少想一点，就地收敛：用于推理压缩的局部偏好学习
hf.summaryZh: 针对大推理模型在已获得足够信息后仍持续思考、推高推理成本的问题，提出局部偏好学习方方法LoCo：从模型自身轨迹中检测候选过度思考状态，冻结对应推理前缀，并从同一状态重新生成更短且经验证的续写，用这些状态条件偏好对做DPO训练，让模型学会在当前状态下何时继续推理、何时收尾。训练数据完全由自生成的数学轨迹构造，在5个数学与3个代码基准上，数学任务完成长度缩短41.7%–45.4%、代码任务缩短23.4%–36.3%，同时保持或提升准确率，并在全部代码基准上取得最佳AUC。方法展示了仅用数学数据训练也能跨域迁移到代码生成，为推理成本控制提供了状态级而非轨迹级的压缩思路。
hf.reason: 后训练DPO做推理压缩，方法清晰且有跨域迁移结果

hf.title: MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy
hf.abstract: Long-form multi-shot video editing requires an intended edit to remain coherent across abrupt changes in scene, viewpoint, and subject appearance, while processing substantially longer visual context than conventional single-shot editors. We introduce MoviEdit, an end-to-end framework for scalable long-form multi-shot video editing that jointly addresses the challenges of data, modeling, and evaluation. To provide cross-shot supervision data at scale, we develop automatic data-generation pipelines spanning synchronized multi-view footage, real-world multi-shot videos, and generated multi-shot content, yielding 87K paired editing videos without manual annotation. Architecturally, MoviEdit employs a cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive design: a lightweight bidirectional stage first establishes a globally coherent editing draft over a spatiotemporally compressed representation, which is then autoregressively propagated and refined over the full video. We further introduce MoviEdit-Bench, a dedicated benchmark for systematic evaluation of long-form multi-shot video editing. Extensive experiments show that MoviEdit substantially outperforms existing open-source models and performs on par with industry frontier models across text-guided and image-guided editing. Visit our project page for complete results and to access the benchmark: https://multi-shot-edit.github.io/
hf.titleZh: MoviEdit:让长视频多镜头编辑变得简单
hf.summaryZh: 长视频多镜头编辑要求编辑效果在场景、视角与主体外观突变时保持连贯，且需处理远超单镜头编辑器的视觉上下文。为此构建覆盖同步多视角素材、真实多镜头视频与生成式多镜头内容的自动数据流水线，产出8.7万对无需人工标注的编辑视频对;模型采用级联双向—自回归设计，先在时空压缩表示上由轻量双向阶段建立全局连贯的编辑草稿，再自回归地传播并精修至完整视频;同时发布MoviEdit-Bench用于系统评测。实验显示其在文本引导与图像引导编辑上大幅超越现有开源模型，并与业界前沿模型持平。
hf.reason: 视频编辑属视觉生成方向，画像明确低分

hf.title: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
hf.abstract: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shared multimodal foundation model that unifies image, video, audio, synchronized audio--video, and interleaved inputs, is specialized for each downstream module. Because a DiT is trained on far fewer training samples than a language model, we treat captioning as a semantic contract that maximizes description density, and extend it to reference-grounded captioning that makes reference bindings explicit. Prompt enhancement translates user intent into this caption distribution: basic PE is derived from captions of compelling videos and refined with text-level and generator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, while agentic PE refines the story and retrieves compelling examples. We show that a reliable text encoder comes from perceptual training rather than from stronger language ability, and that candidates can be screened from text alone before end-to-end training. Reward modeling pairs a general reward model for explainable, localized critiques with a decision reward model for fast multidimensional scoring, treating perceptual bandwidth as a first-class design parameter. Finally, we review task-specific automatic evaluation, focusing on protocols that expose scoring shortcuts and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for building the understanding stack behind controllable video generation.
hf.titleZh: 视频生成背后：来自可灵（Kling）的多模态理解观察与洞见
hf.summaryZh: 视频生成的瓶颈正从画面渲染转向语义控制，可灵（Kling）把生成质量看作多模态理解在数据—条件—对齐—评测链路上的投影并逐模块复盘。统一的 Kling-MLLM 覆盖图像、视频、音频与音视频同步输入并为下游模块特化；因 DiT 训练样本远少于语言模型，字幕被视为最大化描述密度的语义契约，并扩展出显式绑定参考的 grounded captioning。提示词增强结合文本级与生成器在环的强化学习，文本编码器能力来自感知训练而非更强语言能力，奖励建模由可解释局部点评与快速多维打分两模型配对。评测则聚焦暴露打分捷径、可回溯失败来源的协议。
hf.reason: 多模态理解与奖励建模部分扎实，但整体服务于视频生成

hf.title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
hf.abstract: Learning a universal action representation from video requires modeling dynamics that are consistent across different executions of the same action yet invariant to changes in embodiment and appearance. Existing latent action models infer actions from visual transitions, but their representations often entangle the underlying action with irrelevant visual variations, limiting transfer across embodiments. We introduce DreamX, which repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a universal latent action learner. Our approach extracts compact latent actions from the video model's rich spatiotemporal features, compressing each latent video frame by 300times (1{,200 rightarrow 4} tokens). In addition, by leveraging the video model's generative prior, these latent actions capture action-relevant dynamics disentangled from visual appearance. The resulting latent space serves as a shared action interface across embodiments (human and robot), environments, and action parameterizations. On LARY-Bench, DreamX achieves state-of-the-art performance among latent action models. Moreover, actions encoded in one setting remain effective in another: the latent space supports any-to-any video transfer and zero-shot action transfer across diverse embodiments and environments. Furthermore, this shared interface also enables policy learning in a compact latent action space, reducing the computational cost of video-diffusion-based policies.
hf.titleZh: DreamX：视频扩散模型即通用潜在动作学习器
hf.summaryZh: 从视频中学习通用动作表示，难点在于同一动作的不同执行之间要保持动态一致，同时不受具身形态与外观变化影响。DreamX 将预训练视频扩散模型改作潜在动作学习器，从其时空特征中抽取紧凑潜在动作，把每帧潜在视频由1200个token压缩至4个（300倍），并借助生成先验分离出与视觉外观无关的动作动态，形成跨人类与机器人、跨环境、跨动作参数化的共享动作接口。在LARY-Bench上，其性能在潜在动作模型中达到SOTA；该潜在空间支持任意到任意的视频迁移，也支持跨具身、跨环境的零样本动作迁移，并能在紧凑潜在动作空间中学习策略，降低基于视频扩散的策略的计算开销。
hf.reason: 视频扩散模型加具身动作迁移，属扩散与机器人低分方向

hf.title: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
hf.abstract: General-purpose robot policies must work across robots, tasks, and environments, yet the variation that makes physical trials informative also makes them difficult to reproduce. We introduce RoboColosseum, a distributed evaluation framework that combines unified policy serving and standardized protocols across a network of locally operated robots in diverse environments. Our initial study evaluates five vision-language-action (VLA) policies and three frontier AI agents across four embodiments (SO-101, Franka, Bimanual-YAM, and G1 Humanoid). The Open Track compares models without task-specific adaptation in blinded, pairwise trials under matched local conditions. The Fine-tune Track measures how well VLA policies adapt to 20 tasks across all four embodiments when each policy receives the same 100 demonstrations per task. Across 5,699 pairwise Open Track comparisons at 124 sites, frontier agents rival specialized VLA policies, while all systems struggle to complete open-world tasks reliably. After fine-tuning, GR00T N1.7 leads on SO-101 and pi0.5 leads on Franka and Bimanual-YAM. Policy rankings show weak agreement across embodiment-specific task suites (Kendall W = 0.24). Open Track rankings poorly predict relative performance after fine-tuning, with substantial rank reversals on all three embodiments shared between tracks. Measuring partial progress reveals differences that task success alone misses. On the G1 Humanoid, no policy completes any of the five tasks, yet average progress ranges from 13.3% to 23.2% across policies. Open Track rankings stabilize as trials accumulate, and active matchmaking achieves comparable ranking agreement with substantially fewer physical trials than uniform sampling. These results show how distributed physical evaluation can reveal where robot policies generalize, how well they adapt to new tasks, and how far they progress on tasks they fail to complete.
hf.titleZh: RoboColosseum:大规模评估真实开放环境中的物理智能
hf.summaryZh: 真实机器人评测难以复现，跨本体、任务与环境的变化正是难点。RoboColosseum 用统一策略服务与标准化协议连接多地本地运行的机器人，在 SO-101、Franka、Bimanual-YAM、G1 四种本体上评测五个 VLA 策略与三个前沿 Agent，分设免适配盲测与等量示范微调两条赛道。124 个站点 5,699 次配对比较显示:前沿 Agent 与专用 VLA 相当，但都难以稳定完成开放世界任务;跨本体排名一致性很弱(Kendall W=0.24)，免适配排名无法预测微调后表现，G1 上无一策略完成任务而平均进度仅 13.3%–23.2%。
hf.reason: 机器人 VLA 评测，属具身智能低分方向

hf.title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
hf.abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introduce Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed), which decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings. Rather than directly projecting the composed query into a single embedding without internal reasoning, FactEmbed employs a set of factorized latents that simulate the intended visual modifications via an intermediate target imagination objective. This process encourages the latents to ground into target semantics before forming discriminative representations for retrieval. Subsequently, to propagate these factorized representations throughout the model for retrieval, we optimize a factor-level contrastive loss while distilling the decomposed representations into a deeper attention layer of the MLLM. Finally, for efficient inference, we retain the [EOS] token to establish a global-level embedding on top of these factorized latents, while we exploit the mean-pooled factorized latents to rerank a short candidate list at negligible cost, as both are produced by the same forward pass. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FactEmbed outperforms prior works across CIR benchmarks.
hf.titleZh: 面向组合图像检索的因子化MLLM嵌入
hf.summaryZh: 组合图像检索（CIR）需在给定参考图与修改文本时找出目标图像，现有基于MLLM的做法仅靠对比监督把组合查询直接映射为单一检索嵌入，未显式解析文本所指的视觉修改，组合理解能力被浪费。FactEmbed把组合查询理解与判别性嵌入构建解耦：用一组因子化latent经中间「目标想象」目标模拟预期视觉修改，使latent先落地到目标语义，再优化因子级对比损失并把分解表示蒸馏进MLLM更深的注意力层。推理时保留[EOS]token形成全局嵌入，并用同一次前向得到的均值池化因子latent以极低开销对短候选列表重排。在多个CIR基准上优于此前方法，适用于组合检索与多模态嵌入表示学习。
hf.reason: MLLM组合检索嵌入，属多模态理解侧但偏检索任务

hf.title: Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified
hf.abstract: We introduce Axion 1.0, a fully open agent foundation model that combines strong and broad agentic capabilities with a remarkably simple training recipe. Axion 1.0 is trained in only three stages: two lightweight supervised fine-tuning stages followed by reinforcement learning, without dedicated mid-training, direct preference optimization (DPO), or on-policy distillation (OPD). The first SFT stage develops strong self-contained reasoning through model-aware data construction, where we synthesize challenging problems and adversarially strengthen them based on the base model's own successful solution strategies. The second stage extends these capabilities to tool-dependent reasoning through a scalable pipeline for constructing diverse and automatically verifiable tasks grounded in real-world data sources and deterministic computation. Finally, reinforcement learning further strengthens long-horizon reasoning and interaction with external tools and environments. Despite this compact training recipe, Axion 1.0 achieves strong performance across a broad suite of agentic benchmarks and is competitive with leading commercial models on several of them. Equally importantly, Axion 1.0 is open beyond model weights: we release the complete recipe, including data construction, generation, filtering, verification, prompts, and training code, enabling the entire development process to be reproduced and extended. Axion 1.0 demonstrates that strong agent foundation models can be both open and simple, offering a practical and reproducible path toward advancing open agentic intelligence.
hf.titleZh: Axion 1.0：化繁为简的开放 Agent 基础模型
hf.summaryZh: Axion 1.0 用仅三阶段的极简配方训练开放 Agent 基础模型：第一轮 SFT 通过模型感知的数据构造（针对基座模型自身的成功解法合成难题并做对抗性加固）建立自含推理能力；第二轮 SFT 借助可扩展流水线，从真实数据源与确定性计算中构造多样且可自动验证的工具依赖任务；最后用强化学习强化长程推理及与外部工具、环境的交互。配方虽精简，却在多项 Agent benchmark 上表现强劲，部分指标与领先商业模型相当；且不只开放权重，还一并放出数据构造、生成、过滤、验证、prompt 与训练代码，使全流程可复现、可扩展。
hf.reason: 开放 Agent 基础模型的完整训练配方，直接命中 Agent 与后训练方向

hf.title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
hf.abstract: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. As a result, tool interfaces may not match real ones, tool compositions are not grounded in execution, and tasks rarely span more than one environment. We propose ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework that reverses this order. ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies from adjacent calls in execution traces of real MCP services and open agent corpora, using deterministic rules rather than LLM judgment, and clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments. Databases are synthesized only for state-mutating environments, while query and stateless tools replay recorded returns. ToolSpace then performs state-aware random walks with rollback and decompiles each chain into a natural-language task with assertion-based checks, keeping only samples that replay successfully from the initial state. Applied to AutomationBench and tau3-Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which 7 frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points. Across seven long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, ToolSpace raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from 23.0 to 41.0 average score (43.2 with RL) and GLM-5.2 from 44.6 to 56.6, on par with Claude Opus 5. Ablations show that execution-witnessed edges clearly outperform LLM-judged ones, and performance keeps improving with data and environment scale.
hf.titleZh: ToolSpace:为长程 Agent 规模化工具中心的环境合成
hf.summaryZh: 现有 MCP 环境扩展以数据为中心，先合成数据库与场景再派生工具与任务，导致工具接口失真、工具组合缺乏执行依据、任务难以跨环境。ToolSpace 反转这一顺序:从真实 MCP 服务与开放 agent 语料的执行轨迹中，用确定性规则挖掘数据、状态与重试依赖，将加权工具组合图聚类为环境;仅对状态变更环境合成数据库，再用带回滚的状态感知随机游走生成工具链，反编译为带断言检查的任务并只保留可复现样本。在 AutomationBench 与 tau3-Bench Banking 上生成的 Pro 版本使 7 个前沿模型最多下降 38.2 分;在 7 个长程工具基准上，Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 从 23.0 升至 41.0(加 RL 为 43.2),GLM-5.2 从 44.6 升至 56.6。消融显示执行见证的依赖边优于 LLM 判定，且随数据与环境规模持续扩展。
hf.reason: 工具中心的环境合成与 Agentic RL，直接命中 Agent 环境合成方向

hf.title: YANAMI: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Multiturn Stateful Interaction
hf.abstract: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) integrate visual understanding, generation, and editing within a single unified framework. However, existing unified multimodal datasets and benchmarks remain dominated by single-turn tasks. Even in recent multi-turn datasets, many turns can be solved independently without tracking information across turns. Consequently, they provide limited supervision and evaluation for multimodal stateful interaction, which requires models to understand, maintain, update, and faithfully realize evolving dialogue states across turns. To address this gap, we introduce YANAMI, the first large-scale multimodal dialogue dataset and benchmark for stateful interaction, comprising YANAMI-400K and YANAMI-Bench. YANAMI-400K contains 400K multi-turn multimodal dialogues, with more than 2M images and 2.6M dialogue turns. The dialogues span four representative scenarios: Multi-Image Fusion, Image Editing, World Modeling, and Visual Reasoning, and require models to continuously track, preserve, and revise evolving multimodal dialogue states across turns. YANAMI-Bench comprises 400 multi-turn dialogues for systematically evaluating multimodal stateful interaction. It jointly evaluates Dialogue State Understanding and Visual Realization, characterizing the gap between models' ability to understand evolving dialogue states and their ability to faithfully realize them in visual outputs. Experiments show that fine-tuning BAGEL on YANAMI-400K improves image editing, generation, and multimodal stateful interaction by 10.3%, 2.0%, and 13.23%, respectively, while preserving its general visual understanding capabilities. Evaluations on YANAMI-Bench further reveal that existing UMMs still struggle to maintain, update, and visually realize evolving multimodal dialogue states.
hf.titleZh: YANAMI：面向多轮状态化交互的大规模多模态数据集与评测基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有统一多模态模型的数据集与基准以单轮任务为主，多轮样本中也有大量轮次可独立求解，对需要在轮间跟踪并更新对话状态的状态化交互缺乏监督与评测。为此构建 YANAMI-400K，包含 40 万条多轮多模态对话、超 200 万张图像与 260 万对话轮次，覆盖多图融合、图像编辑、世界建模与视觉推理四类场景，要求模型持续跟踪、保持并修正演化的对话状态；同时发布 YANAMI-Bench，含 400 条多轮对话，联合评测对话状态理解与视觉实现。在 YANAMI-400K 上微调 BAGEL 使图像编辑、生成与多模态状态化交互分别提升 10.3%、2.0% 与 13.23%，且保留通用视觉理解能力；基准评测显示现有统一多模态模型在维持与视觉实现演化状态上仍明显不足。
hf.reason: 多模态状态化交互基准，但重心偏视觉生成与编辑，方向擦边

hf.title: VidUEU-Agent: A Data-Curation Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Editing, and Unified Tasks
hf.abstract: The advancement of multimodal learning is heavily constrained by the scarcity and high annotation cost of high-quality instruction data. While raw videos offer an abundant and dynamic source of visual knowledge, transforming them into precise instruction data remains highly challenging. To bridge this gap, we present VidUEU-Agent, an automated pipeline that synthesizes instruction data from raw videos for multimodal understanding, editing, and unified tasks. VidUEU-Agent follows a four-stage pipeline: it performs global perception to filter low-quality shots, mines keyframes and multimodal signals, constructs metadata and routes the metadata to synthesize instruction samples. More importantly, our agent framework can autonomously iterate the data distribution based on downstream training results, thereby optimizing data quality, balance, and training effectiveness. Scaling this pipeline, we construct VidUEU-100K, a large-scale dataset of 100K training samples spanning multiple domains and tasks, providing a robust foundation for developing comprehensive multimodal capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning baseline models on VidUEU-100K yields significant and consistent performance gains across diverse representative benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of our proposed agent framework and dataset.
hf.titleZh: VidUEU-Agent：面向多模态理解、编辑与统一任务的数据策展智能体
hf.summaryZh: 高质量多模态指令数据稀缺且标注成本高，原始视频虽然丰富，却难以转化为精确的指令样本。VidUEU-Agent 采用四阶段流水线：先从全局感知入手过滤低质量镜头，再挖掘关键帧与多模态信号，然后构建元数据，并按元数据路由合成指令样本；它还能根据下游训练结果自主迭代数据分布。基于该流水线构建的 VidUEU-100K 覆盖多领域、多任务，包含10万条训练样本；在其上微调基线模型，可在多个代表性基准上取得稳定且显著的性能提升。该工作把数据策展做成可自我迭代的 agent 闭环，适用于多模态理解、编辑与统一任务的训练数据构建。
hf.reason: 数据策展Agent闭环，命中多模态理解与数据合成方向

hf.title: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
hf.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on collaboration among specialized agents to solve complex tasks. Existing methods improve MAS by refining the prompts, skills, and execution strategies of individual agents based on task feedback. However, improving individual agents does not necessarily lead to better team collaboration. Recent studies have therefore extended evolution to the collaboration level, using collective execution experience to adjust team organization, and inter-agent interactions. Nevertheless, evolving collaboration across heterogeneous tasks remains challenging, as existing approaches often constrain team reorganization within a shared structure and reuse interaction rules across incompatible team contexts. In this paper, we propose EvoTeam, a collaboration-centric evolution framework that jointly evolves team organization, interaction rules, and individual agent skills through execution experience. It maintains a library of reusable teams, selecting or creating agent teams and guiding collaboration through team-specific interaction rules. Collaboration experience accumulates within compatible team contexts, while individual skills remain reusable across teams. Experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness. Our code is available at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/EvoTeam.
hf.titleZh: EvoTeam:通过演化团队实现多智能体协作
hf.summaryZh: 现有 LLM 多智能体系统多靠优化单个 agent 的提示、技能与执行策略来提升效果，但单 agent 变强不等于团队协作更好;已有的协作层演化又把团队重组限制在共享结构内，并跨不兼容的团队语境复用同一套交互规则。EvoTeam 以协作为中心，联合演化团队组织、交互规则与个体 agent 技能:维护可复用的团队库，按任务选择或新建团队，并用团队专属交互规则引导协作，使协作经验在兼容的团队语境中积累，而个体技能可跨团队复用。在四个 benchmark 上验证了有效性，代码已开源。
hf.reason: 多智能体团队演化，直接命中 Agent 方向，方法清晰但非范式级

hf.title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
hf.abstract: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.
hf.titleZh: WebHarbor：将真实网站对接为可演化的GUI Agent环境
hf.summaryZh: 在线网站评测受内容漂移、访问限制与登录态流程覆盖不足困扰，而既有合成环境在功能深度与视觉保真上不足。WebHarbor构建了153个可执行、Docker化的网站环境，以任务驱动的人机协作方式重建真实Web服务的界面、内容与功能工作流，由编码Agent实现功能扩展、人工审核保真度与任务有效性，共包含3518个多步与登录后任务。基于该环境对Qwen 4B级GUI Agent做强化学习，在四个基准上可泛化到未见任务并与主流开源GUI网页Agent表现相当，为稳定可复现的评测与低成本RL训练提供统一平台。
hf.reason: 可演化GUI Agent环境与RL训练，命中Agent方向

hf.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
hf.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. Third, speculative decoding is deployment-specific, and no universal optimization fits every serving regime, drafter, target model and GPU. To address these challenges, we present SpecPilot, an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each deployment. In each round, a cost model locates the largest gaps between the current system and its ceiling. Parallel agents explore directions and integrate the successful ones. Token forcing checks every output token against stock to detect reward hacking. A structured memory carries validated mechanisms to new rounds and deployments. SpecPilot discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms. We evaluate it across four target models, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks. Without training or quality loss, it raises the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46times to 10.87times with one request, and from 1.94times to 3.93times with batching.
hf.titleZh: SpecPilot：面向投机解码的自主算法发现与系统优化
hf.summaryZh: 并行 drafter 的投机解码理论上可一次前向起草整块 token，但现有系统远未达到该上限：单请求下每步只接受少量 token 却要读取全部目标权重，批处理下逐请求验证使相对自回归的加速近乎减半，且最优方案高度依赖具体部署。SpecPilot 构建自主 agent 循环，用成本模型定位当前系统与上限的差距，多个并行 agent 探索方向并整合有效方案，以 token forcing 逐 token 比对原版系统检测 reward hacking，并通过结构化记忆把已验证机制迁移到新一轮与新部署。该循环发现了通用无损 12-bit 权重格式、面向混合循环目标的树验证、两级验证与三种批处理机制；在 4 个目标模型、3 个 drafter、2 种 GPU 平台和 5 个 benchmark 上无需训练且不损质量，将单请求相对 AR 的加速从 4.46 倍提升到 10.87 倍，批处理下从 1.94 倍提升到 3.93 倍。
hf.reason: 投机解码系统优化叠加自主算法发现循环，加速提升显著

hf.title: MoLRSI: A Recursive Self-Improving AI agent for Molecular Discovery
hf.abstract: Molecular discovery requires navigating vast combinatorial search spaces while balancing competing biological objectives. AI agents can automate expert-defined molecular design protocols, but automation alone does not address how to optimize workflows for new tasks or improve their development through experience. Here we introduce MoLRSI, an AI agent that combines systematic optimization of workflows and model architectures with persistent cross-task memory to recursively improve its search policy for molecular discovery. Workflow performance, refinement outcomes, and execution feedback guide subsequent searches, allowing the agent to improve both its workflows and its strategy for developing them. We evaluate MoLRSI in two challenging molecular discovery settings that require balancing competing properties. In antibiotic discovery, MoLRSI developed a screening workflow balancing antibacterial activity, cytotoxicity and structural novelty, achieving an experimental hit rate of 15.9%, compared with 8.7% for a previous expert-led workflow using the same training data and screening library. In de novo peptide-MHC binder design, MoLRSI developed workflows that jointly consider target binding and specificity, producing eight experimentally validated hits against MART-1 and SARS-CoV-1 pMHCs with preferential binding over tested off-targets while Claude Science completely failed. These findings demonstrate how experience-guided workflow optimization can address competing discovery objectives while improving the search strategies used in subsequent campaigns.
hf.titleZh: MoLRSI：一个用于分子发现的递归自我改进 AI agent
hf.summaryZh: 分子发现需要在巨大的组合搜索空间中平衡多个相互冲突的生物学目标，仅靠自动化执行专家设定的流程，无法解决如何针对新任务优化工作流、以及如何从经验中持续改进的问题。MoLRSI 将工作流与模型架构的系统性优化同跨任务的持久记忆结合，以工作流表现、精化结果与执行反馈指导后续搜索，从而递归地改进自身的搜索策略以及开发策略。在抗生素发现任务中，其筛选流程同时兼顾抗菌活性、细胞毒性与结构新颖性，实验命中率达 15.9%，高于同等数据与筛选库下专家主导流程的 8.7%;在 de novo peptide-MHC 结合子设计中，产出的八个经实验验证的命中对 MART-1 与 SARS-CoV-1 pMHC 具有优于脱靶的偏好性结合，而 Claude Science 完全失败。结果表明经验引导的工作流优化可同时处理相互竞争的目标，并提升后续任务中的搜索策略。
hf.reason: 递归自我改进 agent 机制有方法学价值，但落在分子发现垂直应用

hf.title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
hf.abstract: Harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents without modifying model weights, but existing methods primarily optimize response quality. Extending them to joint quality--cost optimization introduces a challenge: applying the deployment preference during intermediate updates can prematurely reject candidates that are valuable for later improvements. We introduce ParetoSaddler, which addresses this mismatch by separating intermediate candidate promotion from final deployment selection. At each iteration, an optimizer updates a parent harness to produce a candidate, and then compares the two over repeated executions and uses Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support to promote candidates showing credible progress in either quality or cost. Promoted candidates receive broader development evaluation and remain available as parents for later optimization steps. We evaluate ParetoSaddler on ClawMark and GAIA2 using domain-disjoint splits. On ClawMark, ParetoSaddler improves quality from 70.86\% to 81.35\% while reducing cost from \1.17 to 1.01 per task; on GAIA2, it improves quality from 56.22\% to 62.89\% while reducing cost from \0.78 to 0.45 per task. The Pareto-selected harnesses also achieve higher quality at lower cost than quality-only harness optimization. Analysis shows that Pareto-aware optimization retains intermediate candidates that would be discarded by deployment preference but can support later improvements, while Bayesian bootstrap screening filters out candidates whose gains are weakly supported across runs.
hf.titleZh: ParetoSaddler：面向质量与成本的 Agent Harness 帕累托引导优化
hf.summaryZh: 现有 agent harness 优化只关注回答质量，若把部署偏好直接用于中间更新，会过早淘汰对后续改进有价值的候选。ParetoSaddler 将中间候选晋升与最终部署选择解耦：每轮由优化器改写父 harness 生成候选，经重复执行与贝叶斯自助帕累托支撑检验，只要质量或成本有一侧呈现可信进步即予晋升，并保留为后续优化的父代。在 ClawMark 与 GAIA2 的领域不相交划分上，质量分别从 70.86% 提升到 81.35%、从 56.22% 提升到 62.89%，单任务成本从 1.17 降至 1.01、从 0.78 降至 0.45。该方法在不改动模型权重的前提下实现质量与成本的联合优化，优于仅优化质量的 harness 方案。
hf.reason: Agent harness 自动优化并兼顾成本，属 Agent 与后训练交叉的扎实工作

hf.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
hf.abstract: Effective computer-use agents (CUAs) should seamlessly combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution within a single policy. We present Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4B hybrid CUA trained from a general multimodally aligned checkpoint through an end-to-end, progressive five-stage curriculum across midtraining, SFT, and RL. To power this curriculum at scale, Mage-CUA-Forge replaces per-task agent construction with reusable, skill-conditioned generation workflows and application-specific preparers, synthesizing 293,806 desktop and web tasks across 6,915 skills while reducing recurring per-task expenditure by 82.6%. Rather than directly distilling a default teacher, we evolve the teacher harness and instantiate specialized CUA harnesses to yield high-quality trajectories alongside stage-specific supervision. Mage-VL-Cowork-4B finally climbs to 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified through different training stages with more efficient reasoning cost, achieving state-of-the-art performance at its parameter size and pushing forward the frontier of on-device intelligence.
hf.titleZh: Mage-VL-Cowork:通过演化式harness学习混合计算机使用的完整训练配方
hf.summaryZh: 面向真实桌面与网页任务，把视觉GUI操作与代码、终端执行统一到单一策略中，是一个4B混合计算机使用智能体。数据侧以Mage-CUA-Forge用技能条件化的可复用生成工作流替代逐任务智能体搭建，合成覆盖6915项技能的293806个任务，并把单任务重复开销降低82.6%。训练侧从多模态对齐检查点出发，按中训、SFT、RL五阶段渐进课程推进，并通过演化教师harness与专用harness实例获得高质量轨迹与分阶段监督。最终Mage-VL-Cowork-4B在OSWorld-Verified上达66.0%，以更低推理开销取得同参数规模SOTA。
hf.reason: 混合计算机使用智能体的完整训练配方与大规模任务合成，直击Agent方向

hf.title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
hf.abstract: A robot generalist must interpret a scene, act on it, and satisfy every condition of a task. How far do frontier vision-language models (VLMs) meet these demands? We introduce Embodied Agent Arena, evaluating ten VLM agents across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation. Its 1,000 cases combine 32 established sources with GeoProbe, our 168-case benchmark for camera, motion, depth, and scale estimation. A minimal harness leaves task decisions to the model through source-native interfaces. Closed-weight models lead all five domains, whereas open-weight VLMs show useful spatial reasoning but substantially lower planning and manipulation success. Beneath these averages, similar geometric errors conceal different scale and shape distortions, and valid region estimates need not identify usable action points. During execution, agents can achieve early subgoals yet lose object control, bind an action to the wrong receiving region, or stop before the required physical state holds. Additional computation does not uniformly resolve these failures: code repair can restore execution without completing the task, while self-review can reverse correct judgments. Failure costs also differ: the strongest planners concentrate failed-token expenditure in prolonged body-control tasks, whereas other models fail broadly across procedures. Matched traces show how successful recovery uses feedback to restore a missing prerequisite and advance the remaining task.
hf.titleZh: 前沿 VLM Agent 准备好成为机器人通才了吗？基于 Embodied Agent Arena 的实证研究
hf.summaryZh: 构建 Embodied Agent Arena，用 1000 个案例（32 个既有数据源加自建 GeoProbe 168 例）在几何、空间推理、可供性、任务规划与操作五个维度评测十个 VLM Agent，并用最小 harness 让模型经源生接口自行决策。闭源模型在五个领域全面领先，开源 VLM 空间推理可用但规划与操作成功率明显偏低；相近的平均几何误差掩盖不同的尺度与形状畸变，有效区域估计也不等于可执行动作点。执行中 Agent 常达成早期子目标却失去物体控制、绑定错误的承接区域或未达到目标物理状态即停止；增加计算无法统一修复：代码修复可恢复执行却不完成任务，自我复查会推翻正确判断。
hf.reason: 具身操作评测，属机器人方向，仅与 VLM 评测方法沾边

hf.title: "Shall We Approve?" Consequence-Aware Approval for Autonomous Coding Agents
hf.abstract: Coding agents increasingly rely on automated approvers to decide whether a proposed shell command may run. Existing approvers, from rule-based checkers to guardrail models and deployed permission classifiers, base their decisions on the text of the request and command. Yet a command's behavior depends on the code it invokes and the state of the workspace, and systems that observe file changes leave the assessment to the agent or a human after execution. We present Caper, a consequence-aware approval mechanism that pre-executes each command in a snapshotted sandbox, provides an independent approver with a bounded report of its observed effects, commits allowed commands, and rolls back blocked ones with a reason the agent can act on. Compared with six existing systems, Caper achieves the lowest harmful-outcome rate on SABER (6.7% versus at least 14.8%) and YoloFS-Ext, a benchmark we build in which harmful behavior is hidden inside invoked tools (7.8% versus at least 35.3%), while blocking 1.0% of the safe twins of the dangerous tasks in YoloFS-Ext.
hf.titleZh: 「应当批准吗?」面向自主编程智能体的后果感知审批机制
hf.summaryZh: 编程智能体的自动审批器通常只依据请求与命令文本做判断，而命令的真实行为取决于被调用的代码与工作区状态，已有系统又把文件变更的判定推到执行之后。Caper 在快照沙箱中预执行每条命令，向独立审批器提供有界的实际影响报告，放行的命令提交、被拦截的命令回滚并附上智能体可据以行动的理由。在 SABER 上其有害结果率为6.7%(对比系统均不低于14.8%)，在自建基准 YoloFS-Ext(有害行为藏在被调用工具内部)上为7.8%(对比不低于35.3%)，同时对危险任务的安全孪生版本仅误拦1.0%。
hf.reason: 编码智能体命令审批与沙箱预执行，属 Agent 安全方向的扎实工作

hf.title: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
hf.abstract: Foundation models in changing environments can encounter unfamiliar domain knowledge that their original training did not cover. However, new domains rarely provide large amounts of expert-created training data or reliable supervisory signals for further training. We introduce Recursa, a foundation model system that adapts to new domains by learning from its own experience without human experts or a stronger teacher model. Recursa uses a knowledge repository to store what it learns: domain-specific skills and instructions on when to apply them, along with memories of past task experiences and reflections on what to improve. Recursa bootstraps the repository from domain materials and then refines it through recursive self-improvement. It uses parallel learners to execute tasks and synthesize local improvements, then validates and merges the improvements into the knowledge repository. On Harvey LAB's Firm Knowledge benchmark, Recursa raises the all-pass rate on held-out test tasks from 30.0% to 55.0% with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and from 35.0% to 46.0% with Qwen3.8-Flash.
hf.titleZh: Recursa:迈向递归自我改进的基础模型系统
hf.summaryZh: 面向新领域缺乏专家标注数据与可靠监督信号的问题，构建了不依赖人类专家或更强教师模型的自我改进系统。系统以知识仓库为核心，存储领域技能、技能适用时机指令、历史任务记忆与改进反思;先从领域材料引导式构建仓库，再由多个并行学习器执行任务并合成局部改进，经校验后合并回仓库，形成递归自我改进闭环。在 Harvey LAB 的 Firm Knowledge 基准上，留出测试任务的 all-pass 率由 30.0% 提升至 55.0%(DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash)，由 35.0% 提升至 46.0%(Qwen3.8-Flash)。该路线适用于缺少监督信号的垂直领域持续适配与自进化 Agent 系统。
hf.reason: 自我改进与知识仓库式 Agent 自进化，直接命中后训练与 Agent 方向

hf.title: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
hf.abstract: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models by constructing a teacher conditioned on privileged references. However, existing approaches keep the teacher fixed either throughout training by consistently exposing it to the full reference, or within each response by adaptively varying partial reference exposure only across responses. In this paper, we argue that neither of them is sufficient. Instead, every token needs its own teacher, as the teacher preference can vary token by token within the same response. Through a teacher-intervention pilot study, we validate that the teacher preference differs across tokens, and reveal that a preferred teacher can be identified for each token through majority voting and KL-based selection. Motivated by these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. Our method constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, and enables every token to adaptively select its preferred teacher during training. Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to +5.9 over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level. The code is available at https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD.
hf.titleZh: 每个 token 都需要自己的老师:多教师自适应 on-policy 自蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: 针对 on-policy 自蒸馏中教师信号固定、无法随 token 变化的问题，通过教师干预试点实验验证同一回答内不同 token 对特权参考的偏好确有差异，且可用多数投票与 KL 选择为每个 token 定位更优教师。据此构建多教师候选池，让每个 token 在训练中自适应选择偏好的教师进行监督。在 Qwen3 数学推理任务上，该方法稳定优于已有 OPSD 方案，相对基座模型平均增益最高 +5.9，表明 token 级教师自适应对后训练蒸馏有实际价值。
hf.reason: on-policy 自蒸馏的 token 级多教师改进，直击后训练蒸馏方向

hf.title: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
hf.abstract: In-image machine translation (IIMT) replaces text in an image with its translation while preserving the surrounding visual context. Existing task-specific models achieve convincing performance but require massive paired training images before and after translation. As advanced text-to-image (T2I) models have reached a practically usable level of multilingual text generation, we argue that this capability can be transferred to IIMT and present FlowTranslator. It is a training-free IIMT framework that first employs an OCR model and an LLM to generate the translation prompt, which is injected into the T2I-based diffusion model. To optimize the accurate and natural generation of translated text, we introduce two trajectory controls: Region Coupling Release (RCR) partially decorrelates target-branch noise inside the text region early in the trajectory, while Coupling Expansion (CE) amplifies the emerging edit displacement mid-trajectory. Under the EasyOCR read-back protocol, FlowTranslator achieves average PRIM BLEU and COMET scores of 20.6 and 57.2, respectively, substantially outperforming the strong training-based baseline UniTranslator. On the more challenging and realistic whole-image ScenePair photographs translated into Chinese, it reaches 40.1\% exact-match accuracy and surpasses existing editing systems, some of which only address the text-rendering stage rather than the complete IIMT task. These results establish flow-based editing as a strong, fully training-free baseline for IIMT.
hf.titleZh: FlowTranslator：基于流编辑的无训练图像内机器翻译
hf.summaryZh: 图像内机器翻译要在替换图中文字的同时保留周围视觉上下文，现有任务专用模型需大量翻译前后成对图像才能训练。FlowTranslator 完全跳过训练：先用 OCR 与 LLM 生成翻译提示并注入 T2I 扩散模型，再加入两种轨迹控制——区域耦合释放（RCR）在轨迹早期部分解除文本区域内目标分支噪声的相关性，耦合扩展（CE）在轨迹中期放大逐渐出现的编辑位移。在 EasyOCR 回读协议下，PRIM 上平均 BLEU 20.6、COMET 57.2，明显超过训练式基线 UniTranslator；在更具挑战的整图 ScenePair 照片译为中文任务上取得 40.1% 精确匹配率。结果确立了基于流编辑的全无训练 IIMT 强基线。
hf.reason: 核心是扩散图像编辑与 T2I 生成，属低分方向，仅擦边 LLM

hf.title: You don't need long context
hf.abstract: Later tokens are costlier to generate than earlier tokens. On frontier open weight models, the disparity in cost may rise to as much as 7x. Through frequent compaction, we show across a broad range of long-horizon and long-input tasks that frontier language models sacrifice little to no task accuracy when maintaining short contexts. We further demonstrate that LLM performance does not collapse on long-horizon software engineering tasks even when taking at most one action per context, and based on that we outline the concept of semantic state space models (SSSMs). Our findings question the need for long-context language models.
hf.titleZh: 你不需要长上下文
hf.summaryZh: 后段 token 的生成成本远高于前段，在开源前沿模型上这一差距可达 7 倍。工作通过频繁压缩(compaction)把上下文维持在短窗口内，在大量长程与长输入任务上验证任务准确率几乎不损失;并进一步发现，在长程软件工程任务中即使每个上下文只执行一个动作，LLM 性能也不会崩溃。据此提出语义状态空间模型(SSSM)的概念，对长上下文模型的必要性提出质疑，适用于长程 Agent 与上下文工程场景。
hf.reason: 长上下文成本与Agent上下文压缩，切中效率与长程任务方向

hf.title: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
hf.abstract: A robot world model that serves as a simulator must do more than generate plausible videos: it must faithfully follow commanded actions, maintain consistency across camera views, and sustain coherent long-horizon rollouts. We present PrimeSim, an action-conditioned, multiview world model simulator that addresses these challenges through progressive midtraining and posttraining. Starting from a pretrained video generator, we midtrain on 30,110 hours of robot demonstrations spanning 22 platforms. To improve action following, we introduce a unified cross-embodiment action representation and frame-aligned dual-path conditioning to strengthen action-frame correspondence. To maintain multiview consistency, we develop view-aware interleaved attention with explicit camera identities, enabling cross-view information exchange while preserving view-specific representations. We further introduce a fast-video, slow-memory posttraining framework that transforms the bidirectional video generator into an efficient autoregressive simulator. By combining fast causal generation, self-rollout training, and hierarchical temporal memory, PrimeSim mitigates error accumulation from self-generated histories and supports coherent long-horizon simulation. PrimeSim runs at 10.1 FPS, remains stable over long-horizon rollouts on rigid and deformable manipulation tasks, and transfers to held-out platforms within 100 to 200 gradient steps where the pretrained backbone does not. Against five open-source action-conditioned world models it leads four of the five WorldSimProbe suites and posts the best overall EWMBench score, while fine-grained local calibration still trails the field; its rollouts are faithful enough to support GRPO-based policy optimization. We release the model weights, inference code, and training code.
hf.titleZh: PrimeSim：基于大规模跨具身示范的通用世界模型模拟器
hf.summaryZh: 面向机器人策略学习需要可信模拟器这一需求，构建以动作为条件、支持多视角的世界模型，用来替代仅生成看起来合理的视频的做法。方法上先以预训练视频生成器为起点，在覆盖22个平台、共30,110小时的机器人示范数据上做渐进式中训练与后训练：用统一的跨具身动作表示和帧对齐双路条件强化动作与画面的对应，用带显式相机标识的视角感知交错注意力保持多视角一致，再以「快视频、慢记忆」框架把双向生成器转为高效自回归模拟器，结合因果生成、自rollout训练与分层时序记忆抑制误差累积。系统以10.1 FPS运行，在刚性与可变形操作任务的长程rollout中保持稳定，迁移到未见平台只需100–200步梯度更新，在五个开源动作条件世界模型中于WorldSimProbe四项领先并取得最佳EWMBench总分，细粒度局部校准仍落后，生成结果足以支撑基于GRPO的策略优化。
hf.reason: 机器人与具身世界模型模拟器，属画像明确低分方向

hf.title: Can AI Reviewers See Your Efforts to Improve Your Paper? A Large-Scale Study of Paper Revision Trajectories
hf.abstract: AI reviewers are increasingly used to assess scientific manuscripts, yet it remains unclear whether their judgments reflect the improvements authors make through revision. We investigate this question using PaperTrajectory-2026, the 2026 release of PaperTrajectory, a dataset of 6,959 paper trajectories across five AI conferences, with automatic annotations of changes along 14 dimensions and separate judgments of overall quality. The annotations show that major improvements emphasize empirical evidence and framing, while later revisions tend toward incremental improvement. Using independent assessments of manuscript versions from eight AI reviewers, we examine whether annotated major improvements receive higher scores, which revision dimensions are associated with score changes, and whether user opinions can outweigh observed revision gains. Every reviewer leaves scores unchanged on most major improvements, and agreement on the direction of score changes is weak. Revision dimensions show some reviewer-specific associations with score increases, but provide limited predictive discrimination and no consistent guide across reviewers. Even when a revision earns a higher neutral score, a brief negative user opinion can erase or reverse that advantage, with substantial variation across reviewers. These findings show that substantive revisions are not consistently reflected in review scores and that observed scoring gains can be vulnerable to user framing, motivating assessments that connect manuscript evidence to overall judgments and remain stable when no scientific evidence changes.
hf.titleZh: AI审稿人能否看见你为改进论文所做的努力？一项关于论文修改轨迹的大规模研究
hf.summaryZh: 构建PaperTrajectory-2026，覆盖五个AI会议、6959条论文修改轨迹，沿14个维度自动标注改动，并单独评判整体质量；再由8个AI审稿人独立评估各版本，检验被标注的重大改进是否带来更高分数。结果显示，面对大多数重大改进，所有审稿人都维持原分数，且对分数变化方向的一致性很弱；修改维度与提分之间只有审稿人特定的关联，预测判别力有限，跨审稿人没有一致规律。即使某次修改在中性条件下获得更高分，一条简短的负面用户意见也能抹平甚至反转这一优势。这说明实质性修改未被稳定反映在评审分数中，评分易受用户措辞影响，因此需要能把稿件证据与整体判断挂钩、且在科学证据不变时保持稳定的评估方式。
hf.reason: 大规模实证研究AI审稿可靠性，属评测与方法学高分方向

hf.title: Near-Zero Token Embeddings Silently Stall Training in Gated Sequence Models
hf.abstract: Among 291 surveyed open-weight language model repositories (280 distinct embedding tables), 52.6% of untied gated and hybrid checkpoints (20/38) contain reachable input embeddings with norms below 10^{-6}, compared with 0% of weight-tied models. Such near-zero rows can arise during pretraining when unseen rare or template tokens receive zero input gradients while AdamW weight decay shrinks untied embeddings. In tested Transformer configurations, non-initial positions or a BOS token prevent this failure mode. In gated sequence models (Mamba, Gated DeltaNet, xLSTM), a near-zero token can amplify input-embedding gradients by more than 30 orders of magnitude (up to 35). At zero input, current-token readout factors (SiLU gates or linear queries) vanish, suppressing historical-state readout. Residual RMS values can then fall below the square root of the RMSNorm floor across consecutive layers, causing Pre-RMSNorm to amplify backward gradients by up to 10^3 per layer. When a gradient entry exceeds 1.84 times 10^{19}, FP32 global-norm clipping in PyTorch, Hugging Face Trainer, and FSDP2 can overflow to infinity and zero the current batch's gradients. In Telugu continual pretraining of Nemotron-3-Nano-4B, this discards updates on approximately 20% of steps and leaves triggered rows frozen. We propose two remedies. For released checkpoints, GroupClip decouples input-embedding clipping using a 64-bit or rescaled norm; its rescaled implementation eliminates update loss and heals triggered rows in one step with negligible measured end-to-end overhead. For pretraining, GateFloor (SiLU(z) + δ, δin [0.01, 0.1]) keeps the gate positive at zero input, reducing near-zero gradients by 28 orders of magnitude in experiments up to 370M parameters, with perplexity comparable to the baseline.
hf.titleZh: 近零 token 嵌入在门控序列模型中悄然导致训练停滞
hf.summaryZh: 排查291个开源权重仓库发现，52.6%未绑定嵌入的门控或混合模型checkpoint存在范数低于1e-6的可达嵌入行，而权重绑定模型为0%。根源是稀有token的零输入梯度叠加AdamW权重衰减；在Mamba、Gated DeltaNet、xLSTM中零输入使SiLU门或线性查询的读出因子消失，残差RMS跌破RMSNorm下限，Pre-RMSNorm逐层将反向梯度放大至多10^3倍，梯度超过1.84×10^19时FP32全局范数裁剪溢出为inf并清零整批梯度，Nemotron-3-Nano-4B继续预训练中约20%的步因此丢弃更新。为此提出GroupClip（用64位或重标定范数解耦输入嵌入裁剪，一步修复被触发行且开销可忽略）与GateFloor（SiLU(z)+δ，δ∈[0.01,0.1]，370M规模下近零梯度降28个数量级、困惑度与基线相当）。
hf.reason: 门控/混合模型预训练稳定性诊断与修复，机制清晰

hf.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
hf.abstract: Speculative decoding has been treated purely as a systems optimization that speeds up large language model decoding without changing the model behavior. Under this view, the growing effort to train better draft models has been focused solely on acceptance rate. We argue that this view does not hold true for long-horizon agent reasoning. Measuring frontier open-weight models on complex agentic tasks with different speculative decoding approaches, we found that numerical noise grows within verification windows, and the draft acceptance results of the thinking process can change the output distribution of the model after 30 steps, thus noticeably influencing the reasoning accuracy of long-horizon agents in random directions. In this work, we improve the reasoning capability of target models by controlling such noise. While we cannot change the overall token distribution verified by the target model, we can encode critical reasoning with highest precision by training the draft model to be rejected. We identify these points in agent traces and train the draft model to favor adversarial preference. At inference the trained draft and the target part ways precisely at these decision points, verification restarts, so that critical thinking tokens are sampled from the target model and encoded under its least noisy conditions. This approach makes critical reasoning better indexed and more durable over a long horizon. On complex agentic coding benchmarks, our approach raises end-to-end success rate with no change to the target model or its output distribution. Our results recast the speculative decoding mechanism from a pure accelerator into an active allocator for context precision that improves the accuracy of long-horizon agents by training 0.06% to 0.28% of hosted parameters.
hf.titleZh: 对抗式投机推理提升长程Agent表现
hf.summaryZh: 指出投机解码在长程Agent推理中并非纯粹的系统加速：验证窗口内数值噪声会累积，被draft接受的思维token会在约30步后改变模型输出分布，随机影响推理准确率。方法是在agent轨迹中定位关键决策点，用对抗偏好训练draft模型使其在这些点上被拒绝，验证随即重启，关键思维token便由目标模型在最干净条件下采样。在复杂agentic编码benchmark上提升了端到端成功率，目标模型及其输出分布均不变，仅训练0.06%–0.28%的托管参数。
hf.reason: 把投机解码重定位为上下文精度分配机制，直接命中Agent与推理效率方向

hf.title: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
hf.abstract: We introduce Dory1.0-4B, a 4-billion-parameter looped (latent-recurrent) language model with elastic depth: a single checkpoint serves different inference compute budgets. Dory1.0-4B is built on a normalized Transformer (nGPT) backbone with interleaved sliding-window and full-attention layers, organized into an input block, a shared recurrent block, and an output block. At inference, the recurrent block can be applied a variable number of times. We pre-trained Dory1.0-4B on 6 trillion tokens. The first 4.5 trillion tokens were trained in NVFP4, and additional pre-training then extended the context length to 256K tokens. Next, we post-trained the model using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), with a difficulty-aware loop curriculum that routes harder prompts to deeper loops. Increasing the loop count improves accuracy, with the largest gains on coding, agentic, and long-context benchmarks. With two or more loops, Dory1.0-4B outperforms larger models such as Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma 4 12B, and Gemma 4 26B-A4B on average across 12 benchmarks. Looping also makes Dory1.0-4B more token-efficient on agentic benchmarks: with four loops, it generates 1.3-2.5x fewer tokens than with one loop, as the extra computation is spent in latent space rather than on longer outputs. To reduce memory during looping, Dory1.0-4B caches keys and values only from the last loop, keeping its KV-cache footprint equal to that of a non-looped model at any loop count while retaining most of the accuracy gains. We open-source the BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4, and GGUF quantized checkpoints.
hf.titleZh: Dory1.0-4B:一个循环式归一化 GPT 模型
hf.summaryZh: 针对单个模型只能按固定计算量推理这一问题，构建 4B 参数的潜在循环模型:以归一化 Transformer(nGPT)为骨干，交错滑窗与全注意力层，分为输入块、共享循环块与输出块，推理时循环块可重复任意次数以弹性调节深度。预训练 6T token(前 4.5T 用 NVFP4)，再将上下文扩至 256K，后训练采用 SFT 与 RLVR，并配难度感知的循环课程，把更难 prompt 路由到更深循环。两个循环以上即在 12 个基准的平均分上超过 Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma 4 12B 与 Gemma 4 26B-A4B;四循环在 agentic 基准上生成 token 减少 1.3–2.5 倍，且仅缓存最后一轮 KV，显存占用与不做循环的模型相当。
hf.reason: 循环深度架构＋RLVR 后训练，直击架构与后训练方向

hf.title: RoboTryOn: Synthesizing Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Human Videos via Virtual Try-On
hf.abstract: Robot foundation models have shown remarkable performance in robot control, yet adapting them to a new task still relies heavily on teleoperated demonstrations. Egocentric human videos offer a scalable substitute, but overlaying rendered robots on human videos or retargeting human poses into robot actions leaves significant visual or action gaps for high-DoF robot embodiments. To address this limitation, we propose RoboTryOn, which treats human-to-robot translation as virtual try-on: try-on keeps the person and swaps the garment, RoboTryOn keeps the demonstrated motion and swaps the human for the robot. Specifically, RoboTryOn converts a human video into a video of the target robot specified by a reference image, while preserving the original task, objects, and background. To maintain visual consistency, we translate selected keyframes autoregressively and use them to guide video synthesis with motion conditioned on the human hand skeleton. Additionally, we use an inverse dynamics model (IDM) that incorporates depth features to infer action labels from synthesized videos for policy learning. Our experiments across multiple humanoid embodiments show that policies trained with our synthetic data improve the average success rate on novel tasks, including challenging bimanual manipulation, from 2% to 60%, without any real robot demonstration of those tasks. Moreover, training with our synthetic data matches the performance of policies trained solely on teleoperated demonstrations at approximately a third of the collection cost, demonstrating the cost efficiency of our approach.
hf.titleZh: RoboTryOn：通过虚拟试穿从人类视频合成灵巧机器人演示
hf.summaryZh: 高自由度机器人学习新任务仍依赖遥操作示教，而第一视角人类视频虽可规模化替代，却在渲染机器人叠加与人体姿态重定向中留下明显的视觉与动作鸿沟。该工作将人-机器人转译类比为虚拟试穿：保留演示动作、把「人」换成「机器人」，先用参考图像指定的目标机器人自回归翻译关键帧，再以人手骨架为运动条件引导视频合成，保留原任务、物体与背景；随后用融合深度特征的逆动力学模型（IDM）从合成视频推断动作标签供策略学习。在多种人形形态上，仅用合成数据训练的策略将新任务（含高难度双臂操作）平均成功率从2%提升至60%，且达到纯遥操作示教策略的水平，而采集成本约为三分之一。
hf.reason: 核心为机器人操作示教与视频生成，落在低分具身智能方向
